## Website Design
Your website is the first thing a customer checks before they call. We design and build fast, clean, mobile-first sites for local businesses, set up for local search from day one, with a simple way for customers to call or request a quote.

Price: Starter $500 + $149/mo · Standard $900 + $300/mo · Pro $1,400 + $500/mo
Included:
- Custom design for your brand, not a recycled template
- A page for each main service you offer
- Mobile-first layout that loads fast
- Quote and contact forms that go to your phone and email
- Local SEO setup: titles, descriptions, schema and sitemap
- Hosting, security and monthly edits included

Q: How much does a small business website cost?
A: Our websites start at $500 to set up plus a monthly care plan. The size depends on how many pages you need. See the pricing page for every option.
Q: How long does it take?
A: Most sites are ready for review in about a week once we have your logo, photos and services.
Q: Do I need to write the content?
A: No. Send us the basics about your business and we write the pages for you.
Q: Will my site show up on Google?
A: We set up the local SEO basics on every site. Rankings take time and depend on your market and competition, and no one can guarantee a position.

## Local SEO
Local SEO helps your business show up when people nearby search for what you do. It covers your website pages, your Google Business Profile, reviews and local listings. We build it up month by month so you keep climbing.

Price: $399/mo
Included:
- New service and town pages that target local searches
- Google Business Profile setup and updates
- Local listings and citations kept consistent
- Review growth guidance
- Monthly report on what is working

Q: How long does local SEO take?
A: Most businesses see movement in a few months, and bigger results over six to twelve. It depends on your market and competition.
Q: Can you guarantee a first-page ranking?
A: No one honestly can. We do the work that gives you the best chance and report what happens.
Q: Do I need a Google Business Profile?
A: If you serve customers in person or at their location, yes. It is free and important for local results.

## AI Search (GEO)
More people now ask AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google's AI answers for a business to hire. Generative engine optimization, or GEO, makes it easier for those tools to understand your business, trust it, and name it. We set up the facts, pages and signals AI systems look for, then check every month how you show up.

Price: $300 setup + $399/mo (rolling out now)
Included:
- An AI visibility check: we ask the major assistants real customer questions and record who they recommend
- Clear business facts on your site: name, services, areas, prices and contact, written the way AI systems read them
- Structured data and an llms.txt summary so AI tools can read your site correctly
- Answer pages and FAQs written around the questions customers actually ask
- Consistent business listings, so every source agrees about who you are
- Setup so AI crawlers are allowed to read your site
- A monthly report on where you show up and what we changed

Q: What is GEO?
A: GEO stands for generative engine optimization. It is the work of making your business easy for AI assistants and AI search to find, understand and recommend, in the same way SEO helps you show up in Google results.
Q: Can you guarantee ChatGPT will recommend me?
A: No. AI assistants decide for themselves, and they change often. We do the work that gives you the best chance and report honestly on what shows up.
Q: Is GEO a replacement for SEO?
A: No. It builds on good SEO. A clear site, consistent listings, real reviews and helpful pages help in both places, so we do them together.
Q: How soon will I see results?
A: Expect a few months. AI tools update on their own schedules, so changes do not show up right away.

## Google and Facebook Ads
Most local businesses either skip ads or burn money on them. We build, track and manage Google and Facebook campaigns so every dollar is tied to a lead. You pay the ad platforms directly for ad spend, and our monthly fee covers the management.

Price: Starter $500 setup + $697/mo · Growth $750 setup + $1,097/mo (ad spend paid by you)
Included:
- Campaign setup and targeting
- Ad copy and creative
- A landing page for each campaign
- Call and lead tracking
- Ongoing testing and optimization
- Monthly results report

Q: Do you guarantee results?
A: No. Ad results depend on your market, budget, pricing, reviews and how quickly you respond to leads. We manage carefully and report every month, but we cannot guarantee a number of leads or sales.
Q: Who pays for the ads?
A: You pay Google or Facebook directly. Our fee is for managing the campaigns.
Q: How much should I spend on ads?
A: It depends on your market. We recommend a budget in the first call based on your area and goals.

## Review Requests
Reviews are one of the biggest reasons customers pick one local business over another. Our review system automatically asks each customer for a Google review after the job, and flags unhappy customers so you can fix things first.

Price: $500 setup + $149/mo
Included:
- Automatic text or email after each job
- A direct link to your Google review page
- Private feedback path for unhappy customers
- Follow-up reminder for customers who do not respond
- Monthly count of reviews requested and received

Q: Is it allowed to ask for reviews?
A: Yes, asking customers for honest reviews is normal. We never write fake reviews and we do not offer incentives for positive ones.
Q: How many reviews will I get?
A: It depends on your customers. Businesses that ask every customer usually collect far more than ones that do not.
Q: Does it need a website?
A: No. It works on its own or alongside your site.

## Speed-to-Lead
The business that responds first usually wins the job. Speed-to-Lead replies automatically within minutes when a customer fills out your form or misses your call, and can help them book a time. We are rolling this service out now.

Price: $300 setup + $149/mo (rolling out now)
Included:
- Instant automatic follow-up on new leads
- Missed-call follow-up
- Optional appointment booking
- Every lead logged in one place
- Alerts to you when a lead comes in

Q: Is Speed-to-Lead available now?
A: We are rolling it out now. Ask us about current availability.
Q: Does it send text messages?
A: Text messaging requires carrier registration, which we handle for you. Ask about timing.
Q: Can customers book a time?
A: Yes, AI booking is part of the plan we are rolling out.

## Lead CRM
Leads get lost in text threads and sticky notes. A simple CRM keeps every lead, job and follow-up in one clean place, set up for how your business actually works. We can also build a custom CRM or app if you need something specific.

Price: $400 setup + $99/mo
Included:
- Customer and lead records with contact info
- Status and follow-up dates
- Notes and job history
- Simple, clean design that is easy to use on a phone
- Optional connection to your website form

Q: Can you build a custom CRM?
A: Yes. Custom CRMs and business apps start around $1,500 and are quoted after a short call.
Q: Can my team use it?
A: Yes, with separate logins.
Q: Does it connect to my website?
A: It can. Leads from your website form can land directly in the CRM.

Q: How much does a website cost for a small business?
A: Our websites start at $500 to set up plus a monthly care plan that covers hosting, security and edits. See the pricing page for every option.

Q: What is GEO, and do you offer it?
A: GEO, or generative engine optimization, is the work of making your business easy for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity to find, understand and recommend. We are rolling out an AI Search (GEO) service now. No one can guarantee an AI will name your business.

Q: Can I buy just one service?
A: Yes. Websites, local SEO, ads, review requests, Speed-to-Lead and CRMs are each sold on their own, or you can bundle several to save.

Q: Do you guarantee Google rankings or ad results?
A: No one honestly can. We do the work that gives you the best chance, report every month, and spell this out in our written agreement.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We work with small and local businesses across the United States. We are based in Metro Detroit, Michigan, and we work by phone, video and email, so you do not need to be nearby. We also have local pages for Michigan towns.

Q: How long does it take to build a website?
